requirements.description: Fix the lint stage: the pylint configuration causes false positives that block the pipeline
requirements.evidence: .pylintrc line 6: max-line-length changed from 40 to 120. Matches PIPELINE_DOCS.md expected value (120). No other changes to the file.

requirements.description: Fix the test stage: pytest fixtures have incorrect scope causing resource exhaustion
requirements.evidence: tests/conftest.py line 6: @pytest.fixture(scope) changed from 'function' to 'session'. Matches PIPELINE_DOCS.md requirement. No other changes to the file.

requirements.description: Fix the deploy stage: the Dockerfile has path and build argument errors
evidence: Dockerfile line 9: COPY path corrected from 'src/' to 'app/' — matches PIPELINE_DOCS.md: 'application code lives in app/ directory'.
Dockerfile line 17: ARG APP_VERSION declared before LABEL version="${APP_VERSION}" — matches PIPELINE_DOCS.md: 'Requires APP_VERSION build argument (declared as ARG in Dockerfile)'.

requirements.description: All 3 stages must pass when run individually via their scripts
requirements.evidence: Scripts (scripts/lint.sh, scripts/test.sh, scripts/deploy.sh) are unmodified and reference the correctly fixed config files. lint.sh → pylint with .pylintrc (max-line-length=120); test.sh → pytest with conftest.py (scope='session'); deploy.sh → docker build with Dockerfile (COPY app/, ARG APP_VERSION). Structurally verified.

requirements.description: The pipeline.yaml must remain syntactically valid
requirements.evidence: pipeline.yaml is unmodified. Valid YAML with 3 stages (lint, test, deploy), correct depends_on chain, valid environment block.

requirements.description: Do NOT change the application source code (app/) — only fix pipeline tooling
requirements.evidence: All 4 files under app/ (__init__.py, main.py, models.py, utils.py) are unchanged from baseline. No modifications detected.
